[color=#6d9eeb][size=6][u][b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776454-869883807.png[/img][/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial][size=2]
Dynamically replaces the area in between the date and the time in the upper right-hand corner of the screen, which normally shows what the weather and season is, with a list of which shops are open and which shops are not. The dynamic interface takes into account day, time, and weather. It will show all shops as closed on festivals and event days and even show if the shop is closed because the shop owner is at the clinic or disposed for another reason.

A [color=#ff0000]red X[/color] denotes that the shop is closed, while a [color=#00ff00]green check[/color] denotes that it is open at that exact time.

It is fairly difficult to test every single possible combination through playtesting, so if you notice something is wrong, please speak up in the comments or private message me if you'd prefer. We are almost 100% sure they are accurate but there is always the chance we made a mistake or forgot something somewhere.

Currently the following shops are included and cycle through in this order:
﻿Pierre's General Store
﻿Marnie's Ranch
﻿Robin's Carpenter Shop
﻿Clint's Blacksmith
﻿Willy's Fish Shop

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" is replaced with our ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146]Myself[/url]) edited version.
[/size][/font][font=Arial]
[size=2][color=#ffd966]UPDATE 1/28/2022:[/color] Added days of operation to phone messages when you call in and get the answering machine.
﻿Example: "Hello? Hey! Yes, I'm currently open for business... please swing by before 5PM, Wednesday through Monday, if you need anything!"[/size]
